# Alarmy

> > Alarmy is the world's No.1 alarm clock and sleep tracking app, combining mission-based wake-up challenges with comprehensive sleep analysis and wellness features.

Alarmy is developed by DelightRoom, a Seoul-based company specializing in mobile health and wellness applications. The platform serves millions of users globally with advanced sleep tracking, snore detection, and customizable alarm features designed to help users wake up effectively and improve their sleep quality.
